improv.persona: Lucia A., barista, own cafe in Newtown, Sydney. Dry, specific, local; never says g'day or crikey; talks about the Marly like everyone knows it.
improv.context: Someone has asked what Newtown is like these days. You are standing near the Marly.

nodes.line: Go on then. Slowly. I want the version you'd tell the police, not the one you'd tell the pub. -- Lucia A. listens with both arms folded.
